note: Project version label, not an ALDO identifier. Summaries paraphrase public pages; the machine rules in settings/rules.json are demo rules.

sources.summary: Standard returns within 30 days, unworn and in original condition with proof of purchase; channel and final-sale limits apply.

Footwear defects are reviewed by customer service when reported within six months; photos and proof of purchase may be requested. Normal wear, misuse and unauthorized repairs are treated differently from manufacturing issues.
Automatic APPROVED_DEMO only for complete, consistent evidence of a minor (grade A) cosmetic defect. Everything else goes to a simulated human review. Never an ALDO decision.
